Name: Tavern
What it does: Recruit heroes (with the roll), emergency supply. Frequent. No contracts, no tips

Name: Sanctum
What it does: Elemental challenges with a Sigil; shards and stones (unchanged)

Name: Sawmill
What it does: Buy wood (small stock); pitch for the troll's weakness

Name: Quarry
What it does: Buy stone (small stock); locked above the player's tier

Name: Copper mine
What it does: Buy copper (small stock); locked above the player's tier

Name: Iron mine
What it does: Buy iron (small stock); locked above the player's tier

Name: Coal pit
What it does: Buy coal (small stock); locked above the player's tier

Name: Hunting lodge
What it does: Buy a little hide, meat and bone

Name: Smithy
What it does: Buy and sell gear; one blueprint for sale per rotation; iron horseshoe (boss weakness)

Name: Apothecary
What it does: Potions, salves, herbs; heal a hero fully or remove exhaustion for gold; sleeping draught (boss weakness)

Name: Chapel
What it does: Free once per visit: heal a hero fully or remove exhaustion; bless holy relics (+3 Faith); blessing for the next expedition (+5% party damage); font water (boss weakness); sells no holy relics

Name: Market
What it does: Rotating stock, sell surplus, sometimes components; decoy hoard (boss weakness)

Name: Thieves' guild
What it does: Small heists: one hero, 15-30 min, Finesse threat; success pays gold or an item and sometimes the black market tip

Name: Monster lair
What it does: More patrols around it while active; the lair is a big fight (elite, 2-3 heroes) with a large reward

Name: Ruins
What it does: One dig per ruin: the dug ruin disappears and a new one spawns elsewhere 24 h later; other ruins stay diggable. Each dig gives materials and ~25% key fragment; 5 digs in total give a relic

Name: Library
What it does: Train a hero (XP for gold), scrolls, some blueprints

Name: Fishing dock
What it does: Fish (new kitchen ingredient); sometimes the tip for the underwater dungeon

Name: Village fair
What it does: At the market on weekends: contests, special stock, unusual recruits, strong ale (boss weakness)
Note: Absorbs the circus. Left out for now

Name: Treasure spot
What it does: One-off reward from a treasure map or a traveller

Name: Bandit camp
What it does: Threat: Thieves. Loot: gold, stolen items

Name: Goblin raiding party
What it does: Threat: Ambush. Loot: materials, sometimes a trinket

Name: Beast den
What it does: Threat: Beasts. Loot: hide, bone, meat, sometimes a component

Name: Haunted crypt
What it does: Threat: Undead. Loot: bone, relics, key fragments

Name: Elemental rift
What it does: Threat: Element. Loot: shards

Name: Abandoned caravan
What it does: Threat: varies. Loot: materials, consumables, a blueprint

Name: Wanted outlaw
What it does: Threat: Brute. Loot: gold bounty, sometimes a rare item

Name: Hidden den
What it does: One rare class, expensive. Needs a mysterious key; tip source open

Name: Black market
What it does: One rare class, expensive; rare items. Needs a mysterious key; tip from a thieves' guild heist

Name: Underwater dungeon
What it does: Secret dungeon near water. Tip from the fishing dock
